title: The Warranty — EN/HI/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Hindi Italian language learning dry absurdist comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - dry piano, careful pace]
He kept all his warranties in a filing cabinet
In the spare room
Every appliance, every device
Filed alphabetically

[Verse 1 - English]
Seventeen years of documentation, neatly bound
No warranty had ever been needed
Because he had all the warranties
And then the filing cabinet fell down
The filing cabinet had no warranty
It had not come with documentation
He stood there in the spare room
For a considerable amount of time

[Verse 2 - हिन्दी Hindi]
सत्रह साल के दस्तावेज़, साफ़ सुथरे रखे हुए
(Seventeen years of documents, neatly kept)
किसी वारंटी की ज़रूरत कभी नहीं पड़ी
(No warranty had ever been needed)
क्योंकि उसके पास सभी वारंटी थीं
(Because he had all the warranties)
फिर फाइलिंग कैबिनेट गिर गई
(And then the filing cabinet fell down)
फाइलिंग कैबिनेट की कोई वारंटी नहीं थी
(The filing cabinet had no warranty)
वह काफी देर तक वहीं खड़ा रहा
(He stood there for a considerable amount of time)

[Chorus - Italiano]
Tutto era coperto tranne l'archivio
(Everything was covered except the filing cabinet)
L'archivio non aveva garanzia
(The filing cabinet had no warranty)
Tutto era coperto tranne l'archivio
(Everything was covered except the filing cabinet)
Non era fornito di documentazione
(It had not come with documentation)
Rimase lì nella stanza degli ospiti
(He stood there in the spare room)
Per un tempo considerevole
(For a considerable amount of time)
Tutto era coperto tranne l'archivio
(Everything was covered except the filing cabinet)

[Bridge - all three]
He filed this feeling under W — उसने इस एहसास को W के नीचे दर्ज किया — Ha archiviato questa sensazione sotto la W
Too obvious to have a warranty — वारंटी के लिए बहुत स्पष्ट — Troppo ovvio per avere una garanzia
He did not file the new warranty — उसने नई वारंटी दर्ज नहीं की — Non ha archiviato la nuova garanzia
He felt this was the right call — उसे लगा यह सही निर्णय था — Ha ritenuto che fosse la scelta giusta

[Outro]
Filed under W
W के नीचे
Sotto la W
